reason: Aurora runs a free-running requestAnimationFrame WebGL loop (uTime = rAF timestamp) that does not honor prefers-reduced-motion, so every shot lands on an arbitrary animation frame. Proven unstable run-to-run locally (up to ~173k differing pixels).

The animated half of the component inventory: Aurora, SidebarAurora and SidebarAuroraHorizontal all run free-running rAF WebGL loops, and DecryptedText scrambles on a timer. Same instability as ui-aurora--*. Splitting these off is what keeps foundations-inventory--all-components — the other ~68 components — diffable.
